svg.text: ← DO ← «PLAN: all plans ready · groups/order fixed»
← MERGE ← «all groups complete» · «ESCALATE: re-merge or incomplete skip»
← CHECK ← «one group: no MERGE» · «MERGE complete» · «REPAIR completed» · «re-gather: blocked»
← ACT ← «CHECK pass» · «STOP: no revised plan → ACT»

g.text: one subagent · orchestrates, does not decide
pdca cycle · continue from saved PLAN
hands cheap · decisions medium · escalation strong
composite: hands cheap · decisions medium · escalation strong

svg.text: One group — degradation: no worktree and no branches are created, work in the current branch, merge --no-ff is not needed; earlier commits remain, no auto-rollback · push — never

Commit — only in an explicitly authorized collection autocommit mode; otherwise/if forbidden the patch is preserved, there are no commits and no uncommitted branch chain (the exception is a project overlay, not global)
≥2: the barrier waits for terminality of ALL lanes (done | incomplete) — readiness, not success; MERGE only successful (done) tips, incomplete is skipped; conflict → abort → pdca-escalate

C: re-gather stays blocked (no report) — not a defect, no code edits; STOP of the corrective PDCA ≠ EXIT: ACT finalises it as unverified, evidence preserved, no success cleanup; ACT cleans only DONE/merged, incomplete results (branches/patch/pointers) are preserved

Lane (work stream) — one parallel flow of work per group: a separate subagent, its own worktree and branch, tasks strictly one by one, a full pdca cycle per task; groups run in parallel (≤ cap), not tasks inside a lane.
Fallback: pdca-orchestrator unavailable (no agent / subagent_depth < 2 / delegation forbidden) → primary leads the cycle itself · autonomous: Notice: + summary · normal: a message to the user
